title: Transistors on one processor, 1971–2026
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale. Intel 4004 (1971): 2,300 transistors. Intel 8086 (1978): 29,000. Intel386 DX (1985): 275,000. Pentium (1993): 3.1 million. Pentium 4 (2000): 42 million. Core 2 Duo (2006): 291 million. Apple M1 (2020): 16 billion. Apple M3 Max (2023): 92 billion. Nvidia Rubin GPU (2026, two dies in one package): 336 billion. Data: Intel's Microprocessor Quick Reference Guide, Apple's and Nvidia's announcements.
heading: TRANSISTORS PER PROCESSOR · LOG SCALE
